controls: Only listed dataset/query/k/weight tuples. Clean/noisy:k1,3,5; duplicates:k3,5; explicit whole-set vote tie:k2. No arbitrary queries or k.
explanation: Nearest is not necessarily representative. Compare k1 noisy-label sensitivity with k3/5; larger k need not improve every query. Uniform and inverse-distance weights differ. Exact duplicate conflicts produce a vote tie under zero-only inverse weighting; class0 wins the tied class totals, not a causal judgment.

interaction.after_reveal: Compare distances, selected row IDs, votes and explanation; change a listed configuration and complete a changed transfer check. Initial error is recoverable.
interaction.before_reveal: Select predicted class 0/1 (or rejection for a diagnostic) and one authored reason before revealing any output.
interaction.no_mastery: Experiment interaction never awards independent module mastery.

provenance: Wholly fictional authored observations; no production labels or causal claims.
